card.name: Final L in acronyms and names
card.fires_on: The letter L ending a capitalized acronym or coined name, such as PNNL, BNL, INL or INLURIYO. It also fires on L or nl inside gene or drug names like FIP1L1 and galcanezumab-gnlm.
